description: This file defines a Java interface for reading credit bureau loan product mappings within the Fineract project. It declares methods to retrieve credit bureau loan product mapping data, fetch loan products, and read mappings by loan ID.

classes.name: CreditBureauLoanProductMappingReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to access credit bureau loan product mapping data.

methods.name: readCreditBureauLoanProductMapping
methods.description: Returns a collection of CreditBureauLoanProductMappingData representing all credit bureau loan product mappings.

methods.name: fetchLoanProducts
methods.description: Fetches and returns a collection of loan product data related to credit bureau mappings.

methods.name: readMappingByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves the credit bureau loan product mapping for a specific loan product identified by loanProductId.
